verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability for deduplicating or grouping related alerts into a single incident. The closest item, "30 incidents get created at the same time. Acknowledge them with a single tap", describes bulk acknowledgment of many separate incidents. That is an adjacent control, not deduplication or grouping, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an SRE, duplicate and related alerts are deduplicated and grouped so one incident pages one human, not fifty
